author: neatcleaver
body:
Don't worry about what path you wanna take, you'll unlock every class eventually and skills carry over. It's not a game that locks you into choices until super endgame and even then it's not permanent 

Mimic head is fine but got farming only, not that useful right now

For now just keep going, you'll replace gear quickly until tier 6+ where you can upgrade a little if you get stuck, though using whetstones for the free weapon upgrade is always good

I would advise you to follow the oracle quest and build a temple, because you will want to do memory hunts to ensure you have enough orns to unlock your classes as you level

author: petr1petr
body:
follow story quest - it will teach you something about the game.

class - whatever you like - I started as mage, because it has simple access to various elements, making it easier to kill everything. some people love melee, wearing arrows in offhand, for dmg without mana cost.

join active kingdom - check settlements around you to see who is active in your area. Kingdom mates should be able to help you with everything.

if you want to know more, go to youtube, find Shabbash and check on his guides - they may be a bit outdated, but it will give you general picture what to do.

Have fun!
